'''Columns-list''' is wrapper template that turns a list into a list with columns. It's a rudimentary variant of the template from wikipidea see [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Columns-list Columns-list] [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Div_col Div_col]. 

== Use ==
The width of each column may be specified using <code>colwidth</code> and a value in ems (default:20em).
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>columns-list|colwidth=''width''|
 ''Text (usually a list)''
 <nowiki>}}</nowiki>
Here, ''width'' specifies the width of the columns, and determines dynamically the number of columns based on screen width; more columns will be shown on wider displays.

== Example ==

colwidth=20em
{{columns-list|
* a
* b
* c
* d
* e
* f
* g
* h
}}

colwidth=30em
{{columns-list|colwidth=30em|
* a
* b
* c
* d
* e
* f
* g
* h
}}
